title: dspy
summary: DSPy is a framework for algorithmically optimizing Language Model (LLM) programs. It enables developers to compose complex LLM workflows using declarative modules and signatures, then automatically improves their performance through advanced teleprompters. By separating program logic from prompting, DSPy makes LLM applications more robust, reliable, and easier to develop and evaluate.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User
nodes.description: The human actor who designs, builds, optimizes, and evaluates DSPy programs to solve complex tasks using Large Language Models.

nodes.label: Core Building Blocks
nodes.title: Core DSPy Primitives
nodes.description: Defines the foundational classes like `dspy.Module` and core data types, providing the basic structure for all DSPy programs and interactions.

nodes.label: Define LLM Programs
nodes.title: DSPy Program Execution
nodes.description: Enables users to compose complex LLM workflows using declarative signatures, advanced prediction modules (e.g., ReAct, CoT), and integrated retrieval mechanisms.

nodes.label: Connect to Language Models
nodes.title: Language Model Integration
nodes.description: Manages all interactions with various Language Models, including client connections, data adaptation for structured I/O, caching, and streaming capabilities.

nodes.label: Manage Data & Utilities
nodes.title: DSPy Data & Utilities
nodes.description: Provides tools for loading, managing, and splitting datasets, along with general-purpose utilities for text processing, configuration, and asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Optimize & Evaluate Programs
nodes.title: Optimization & Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers a suite of teleprompters for automated prompt engineering and program refinement, coupled with metrics for rigorous performance assessment and debugging.

groups.label: Program Construction
groups.title: Building DSPy Programs
groups.description: This group encompasses the foundational elements and core logic for defining and structuring DSPy programs, from basic modules to complex LLM workflows.

groups.label: External Interactions & Data
groups.title: LM & Data Management
groups.description: This group handles all aspects of connecting DSPy programs to external Language Models and managing the flow and processing of data, including caching and streaming.

groups.label: Performance Improvement & Assessment
groups.title: Optimization & Evaluation
groups.description: This group provides the tools and methodologies for automatically improving the performance of DSPy programs and rigorously evaluating their effectiveness.
